summary: Select an explicit source table family and variant; J12 uses the qualified high-precision reconstruction of the source two-sided Padé equations.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Z_J(z)=sum_j b_j/(z-c_j). Historical lower-order families and source ordering retained; regenerated J12 is an intentional numerical correction, not historical numeric identity.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model selecting the legacy table family.
inputs.constraints: One of es1d, es3d, em; selects its explicit source-family table.

inputs.name: J
inputs.constraints: ES1D supports J=2,3,4,8,12; ES3D and EM support J=4,8,12. Unsupported orders fail without fallback.

inputs.name: opt
inputs.description: ES1D variant: None selects 2 for J4, otherwise 1; explicit 1 or 2 accepted. Only J4/J8 change table values. Other models ignore opt.
inputs.constraints: When model=es1d, resolved opt must be integer 1 or 2; ignored for ES3D/EM.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Dimensionless state: J is a native (1,1) scalar; bzj and czj are complex (1,J) rows in the selected table order.
outputs.constraints: Native row shapes preserved. Table selection alone is not an approximation-error or physical-mode certificate.

outputs.name: receipt
outputs.description: Frozen NativeReceipt for an executed native relation; execution provenance is separate from scientific validity.
outputs.constraints: Execution provenance does not certify scientific validity by itself.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
excluded: Unsupported orders do not silently fall back.
Finite-J approximation accuracy is not uniform over the complex plane.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid model, unsupported J or invalid ES1D opt.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError retains its NativeReceipt for unavailable, failed or timed-out owned-scratch execution; no checkout/network fallback.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative coefficient construction; fixed table access does not certify approximation accuracy.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel implements the declared finite-pole or magnetized PDRK relation in Python with bundled native relations where the public callable requires them; direct tests define the bounded numerical cases.
public_references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
provenance.license_status: Attribution and source obligations follow licenses/pdrk/NOTICE; the bundled Faddeeva component follows licenses/pdrk/Faddeeva-Ikuma-BSD-2-Clause.txt. The PDRK notice does not grant unrestricted redistribution.

example.description: Run the declared PDRK relation with its native-backed scientific ports.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.rational import pole_table
r = pole_table('es1d', 8)
assert r['state']['czj'].size == 8
